Subject: POC timeline & success criteria - Acme Industries

Hi Alicia / Tom

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned ahead of the trial kickoff: 

Success criteria (Agreed on call):
- End-to-end latency for summary pipelines <= 300ms p95 under sample load (see sample traffic attached)
- Semantic search recall >= 85% against the provided evaluation set
- Integration stability: zero critical errors in 2-week trial
- Ops handoff: infra playbook + runbook validated by Acme SREs

POC evaluation plan & milestones (proposed):
1) Kickoff (Week 0) - Project kickoff, access/credentials, sample dataset delivery (target: 2026-06-17)
2) Week 1 - Baseline runs & configs; initial latency/cost profile
3) Week 2 - Model tuning, caching enabled; weekly check-in
4) Week 3 - End-to-end validation vs success criteria; final readout prep
5) Final readout (end of Week 3) - Demo results, recommended config, next steps for production

Ownership:
- Redwood POC owner: me (Marissa) - overall coordination, kickoff, demos
- Technical lead (Redwood): Vivek Kulkarni - runtime/config tuning, bench
- CS lead (Redwood): Monica Patel - onboarding, weekly check-ins
- Security/compliance (Redwood): Neha Kapoor - security questionnaire & network requirements
- Acme stakeholders: Alicia (Product), Tom (Infra), Sam (IT/network)

Immediate next steps:
- I'll send the formal trial plan and attach the success criteria doc.
- Alicia/Tom: please confirm the kickoff date (we suggested 6/17) and add Sam (IT) to the thread for network details.
- Acme: share sample dataset and a small evaluation set (CSV or S3 link) by EOD Monday if possible.

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria.pdf (summary), redwood_trial_plan_v1.xlsx (detailed timeline)

Thanks
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
